```yaml
name: Publish Skills to ClawHub

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - '.skills/**'
      - 'skill.md'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      force:
        description: 'Force publish all skills'
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: false

jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Get changed files
        id: changed-files
        uses: Ana06/get-changed-files@v2.3.0
        with:
          format: space-delimited
          filter: '.skills/**'

      - name: Install ClawHub CLI
        run: |
          npm install -g @openclaw/clawhub-cli

      - name: Publish changed skills
        if: steps.changed-files.outputs.modified != '' || steps.changed-files.outputs.added != '' || inputs.force == true
        env:
          CLAWHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CLAWHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          if [ "${{ inputs.force }}" == "true" ]; then
            echo "Force publishing all skills..."
            clawhub publish .skills --accept-license-terms
          else
            CHANGED_SKILLS=$(echo "${{ steps.changed-files.outputs.modified }} ${{ steps.changed-files.outputs.added }}" | tr ' ' '\n' | grep -E '^\./skills/' | sed 's|^\./skills/||' | sort -u)
            if [ -z "$CHANGED_SKILLS" ]; then
              echo "No skill files changed."
              exit 0
            fi
            echo "Publishing changed skills: $CHANGED_SKILLS"
            for skill in $CHANGED_SKILLS; do
              clawhub publish .skills/$skill --accept-license-terms
            done
          fi
```
